issue.body:
Hi. Thanks for pm2.

So, there are two tasks started under pm2: task1 and task2.

pm2 goes to infinite restart loop (on task1) when the task1 performs `child_process.exec('pm2 reload task2')`. os: ubuntu~14.04.1 x86_64 3.19.0-47-generic
node: v6.0.0

Tasks have been started in fork mode, No clusters or so on.

issue.title: A possible regression from 1.0.2

repository.name: pm2
repository.description: Node.js Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

issue.body:
# I'm upgrading an older project to use the latest version (1.1.3 as of now) to take advantage of some of the new features but I bumped into an issue which actually seems to be a regression from 1.0.2 (the actual project used 0.15.x).

I trimmed down the app to a [small reproduction sample](https://gist.github.com/jiripospisil/af2cb66601dc7a933655616cd8dec2f9) which will hopefully demonstrate the problem. There are two processes - FOO and BAR. FOO is a process which continuously prints a text message and BAR periodically restarts FOO. This works with 1.0.2 but fails with 1.1.x - the BAR process will keep restarting itself and eat more memory.

``` bash
git clone git@gist.github.com:af2cb66601dc7a933655616cd8dec2f9.git
cd af2cb66601dc7a933655616cd8dec2f9
nvm install && npm install

# Tab 1
npm run logs

# Tab 2
npm start
```

This should work fine and the log should be pretty calm. The FOO process will keep printing its message and BAR will restart it every 5 seconds. Now kill PM2 (and the log in the other tab), change the version to 1.1.3 and start again.

``` bash
npm stop
npm i pm2@1.1.3
npm start
```

In this case, you should be seeing a lot more activity in the log and the BAR process restarting itself over and over again. I'm not sure whether I'm doing something stupid or missed some breaking change announcement. In any case, please have a look. Thank you!

Note that the sample (and the old app) is running on Node.js 4.4.5 but I managed to reproduce it on 6.2.0 as well.

issue.body:
I am using pm2 for some continuous integration via webhooks from GitHub. So I have two processes being monitored by PM2:
1. git-hooks - this responds to push notification from github webhook to launch a shell script node-deploy.sh
2. cloud-production - this is my production app

Here is the shell script that is used by git-hooks to restart the cloud-production app, node-deploy.sh

```
#!/bin/bash
git checkout production
git pull
npm install
pm2 restart cloud-production  
```

1. git-hooks spawns the node-deploy.sh script
2. The first 3 steps of git checkout, git pull and npm install happen correctly
